allowanceReason: yarn build syncs board directory data from bitsocialnet/lists, and that data is in the startup bundle
ceilingReason: index.html carries the static board frames: a desktop and a mobile template shared by every directory board plus each board's title and winner line (about 59 KB raw, 6 KB gzip); the English interface strings ship with the app (about 37 KB raw), as every language falls back to them and the first render waits for them
